h: Wembley on match and gig days
p: This end of Wembley High Road is within walking distance of Wembley Stadium, and the giant arch is visible from all around. On event days, the area gets very busy, with crowds coming through from Wembley Park and Wembley Central stations, so allow extra time if you're visiting then.

Around the stadium, the OVO Arena Wembley hosts big concerts, and the London Designer Outlet and Boxpark have plenty of food and drink. Wembley Central station, on the Bakerloo line and Overground, is at the other end of the High Road.
Silvertime is an 18+ venue, so it's one for the grown-ups only.
